data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate's incurred claims, net of reinsurance, from past accident years developed favourably by $0.3 million during year (favourably by $0.5 million in 2014). This positive development of run-off losses during the year reflects loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes, particularly Superstorm Sandy.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Loss reserve reductions on past catastrophe claims leading to favourable development (run-off) of prior accident years.

named_events.loss_description: Loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes; cited as a driver of favourable prior-year development.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4242 reported a modest favourable prior-year development for accident years prior to 2015. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2011-2013) produced a net favourable reserve movement of approximately $1.34m (release), driven primarily by run-off and reserve reductions on past natural catastrophe claims (notably Superstorm Sandy). The balance sheet opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was $9.132m.
raw_causal_phrases: developed favourably by $0.3 million during year
loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes, particularly Superstorm Sandy

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding, 2014 comparative column). Prior-year development (gross) was not explicitly provided as a single gross figure; it was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 49) comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2013, giving an aggregate favourable movement of approximately $1.342m. The report's narrative quotes a NET favourable movement of $0.3m; that is net of reinsurance. LOB-specific amounts for prior-year movements are not quantified in the report and have been inferred where noted (confidence reduced). All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and expressed in millions; underlying tables are presented in $000 in the report.
